entries.zh: 珠帘；用细珠（aljófar，小珍珠）串成的门帘，悬于门前。
entries.en: bead curtain; a doorway hanging made of strings of seed pearls
door curtain; a hanging or screen hung before a doorway
curtains and hangings; door curtains
beforehand, in advance; first, previously

entries.zh: 抢先；提前行动；先发制人。
entries.en: to act in advance, to pre-empt; to get ahead of someone
entries.notes: L 明为「抢先、预先行动」，而 H「反」义域较宽（翻转、相反），R 又标[疑]，判为编者近似取字，词义仍以 L 立。

entries.en: old, aged; ancient; former
entries.notes: 「老」字明确；M 并列 lò、lau 两读，(chàng) 疑为「曾」（从前）之音写而未定，R 尾韵 au/ou 存疑。

entries.en: elderly; an elder, an old person
aged, old (of a person)
entries.notes: L 标[残]（biejo 即 viejo），M 声调 T99；H 年老与 R liên làu 足以定「年老」，仅字形残缺。

entries.en: formerly, in times past; of old
entries.notes: L 标[残]，M 作 cot 与 R sīg（昔，sik）不相合，据 H「昔」与 L「antiguamente」取义。

entries.en: in former days, in the old days; formerly
entries.notes: 首字 sīg 为「昔」；第二音节 M 作 xĩ、R 作 xiē，对音不一，疑为「日」。

entries.en: ancient, old; of old times
in olden times, in days of old
in old times; formerly
entries.notes: M 栏标[划删]，疑校者删去与前条重复之形；H 古時、R cù zû 仍清晰。

entries.zh: 古董；古物；因年代久远而受珍视的旧物。
entries.en: antique, curio; an old object prized for its age
ancient and modern; past and present
former, old; bygone
beginning, first; from the outset
entries.notes: L「ab oeel principiu」有讹（标[疑]），义为「自最初起」；H 初、R chǒ 相合。

entries.en: at first, in the beginning; the outset
entries.notes: M 作 tāu（頭）、R 作 keù，[疑:k/t] 未能定读；H 初頭 明确，词义可定。

entries.en: at first, in former times
entries.notes: M 第二音节 sy 旁注[疑:sy/chī]，R 作 zû；H 初時 与 L「tiempo antiguo」相合。

entries.en: antiquity, times long past; of old
entries.notes: L 标[疑:passante/passamte]，R 首字标[疑:v/w]；H 往古 与 M óng coù 足以定义。

entries.en: long (in time), of long duration
entries.notes: M 读 (cou) 加括弧、R 作 quǐn 并标[疑:q/g]；H 久 明确，取「长久」。

entries.en: for a long time; enduringly, long-lasting
entries.notes: M 读置于括弧、R 作 quǐn quǐn 并标[疑:q/g]；H 久久 明确，取「长久、许久」。
